items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 with metadata. All volumes (40–200 µL) use the p300, and wells stay under 360 µL (max 90+200). Labware and labels match the task. The tip-rack pause is harmless.

The helper does pick_up_tip before every aspirate and drop_tip after every transfer, so each well gets a fresh tip. Checks tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination all passed.

All 13 steps run in order with the right volumes: 40 beads with a 10x mix, 90 supernatant, two 200 µL ethanol add/remove cycles, 50 µL water with a 10x mix, 45 µL to the matching elution well. The incubation, magnet and drying steps are recorded with protocol.comment, and end_state checks pass.
transfer(40, beads, sample, mix_after=(10, 50)) runs for all 96 wells, and the 5 min incubation comment comes before the magnet comment.
The engage-magnet and wait-5-min comment comes first. Then 90 µL goes from every well to waste, followed by two cycles of 200 µL ethanol added and 200 µL removed to waste.
The code records the 5 min air-dry comment and the disengage comment. It then adds 50 µL water with a 10x mix, and records the 2 min incubation and the magnet re-engage.
zip(samples, eluates) moves 45 µL from each sample well to the same-named elution well, using the same well_names order for both plates.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly, and all measured checks passed. It follows the task steps and quantities in order, using a fresh tip for every transfer and keeping sample identity from the sample plate to the elution plate.
